componentAssertions: Fresh buffer disables undo and redo.
One-character edit enables undo and disables redo; actual button undo restores CRLF base and clean, enables redo.
Mouse-down preserves editor focus; both mouse and keyboard-origin button activation restore editor focus.
Button redo restores the edit and dirty state; second undo returns clean with redo available.
After 4 seconds no checkpoint or save API is called when immediately undone to base.
A read-only file disables both directions even when a history branch exists.
Switching documents never applies a previous file history to the current file; remount retains each buffer own history.
